title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Look at the pattern of the points in the scatterplot. Consider how the function $$f(x)=|x|$$ might transform the x-values and how this could affect the linearity of the data.

title: Analyzing $$f(x)=|x|$$
text: If $$f(x)=|x|$$, how does this function affect negative x-values?

title: Effect on Linearity
text: Consider whether transforming x-values with $$f(x)=|x|$$ could allow the data to be represented as a linear combination in the model $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$.
